Townhouse for Sale in Bliss 2, Arabian Ranches 3

Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional 4-bedroom duplex townhouse in Bliss 2, Arabian Ranches 3—the newest handover phase and one of Emaar's most sought-after family communities.

This spacious home offers contemporary architecture, premium finishes, and an open-plan layout that perfectly blends style and functionality. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the interiors with natural light, while the private garden provides the perfect setting for outdoor living and entertaining.

Whether you're searching for your next family home or a high-performing investment, this property offers the ideal combination of space, privacy, and lifestyle.

Property Features:
4 Spacious Bedrooms
Maid's Room
Duplex Layout
Bright Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
Modern Open Kitchen
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Private Garden
Balcony
Covered Parking
Premium Emaar Finishes
Community Amenities:
Resort-Style Swimming Pools
Fully Equipped Gym
Community Centre
Landscaped Parks
Kids' Play Areas
BBQ Areas
Sports Courts
Walking & Cycling Trails
Retail & Supermarket
24/7 Gated Community

Bliss 2 is one of the most desirable communities within Arabian Ranches 3, offering a peaceful family lifestyle with excellent connectivity to major highways, schools, Downtown Dubai, and Dubai International Airport. Inspired by contemporary architecture and surrounded by green open spaces, it delivers a unique balance of luxury and everyday convenience.
